answer.says: Ramesh, I am hungry. Please put a plate together for me: the rice, the dal, and a fried egg. I will eat in the study.
answer.thought: The body insists on its rights, as Jacobi observed; I cannot philosophize on an empty stomach. The heat has exhausted me, and the meal is the immediate necessity that must be satisfied before any further reflection is possible. I am grateful to Ramesh for his promptness, even if the food is simple.
